senses.gloss: שַׁלֵּב (b. h. , v. לָבַב) to join, fit in with mortise and tenon. Part. pass. מְשַׁלַּב; pl. מְשַׁלְּבִין.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 26:17">Targ. O. Ex. XXVI, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 36:22">XXXVI, 22</cite>.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 73b">Kidd. 73ᵇ</cite> top <he>מְשַׁלְּבֵי הדמיה</he> R. Ḥan. (ed. <he>משלטי</he>) if the limbs (of the exposed infant) are set (v. <cite ref="P01091"><he>עָצַב</he></cite>).
